newsitem.title: GERMANY: Suedchemie says plans capital raising.
newsitem.headline: Suedchemie says plans capital raising.

text.p: German chemicals company Sued-Chemie AG said on Saturday it plans to raise its capital by 3.8 million marks to a nominal 44.4 million marks in a share issue.

The company said in a statement it would announce details of the issue in mid-February and that the new shares will be fully entitled to a dividend for 1997. The company also plans to issue employee shares for the first time since 1988.
The proceeds from the capital raising will be used for investment in the expansion of its business, the company said.
